summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the open standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data sources, and services via JSON-RPC over HTTP or stdio. By 2026, the ecosystem spans reference servers, vendor-hosted remote servers (GitHub, Vercel, Stripe, Notion, Figma), aggregator platforms, and gateways — with the TypeScript and Python SDKs reaching 97 million monthly downloads in March 2026, a 4,750% growth in 16 months. This matters because MCP lets AI agents discover and invoke real-world capabilities securely without bespoke integrations per tool.
ecosystem_note: Individual MCP servers expose one service's capabilities (e.g. GitHub, Playwright), aggregators bundle hundreds or thousands of servers behind a single unified endpoint (e.g. Composio, Smithery), and gateways/proxies sit in front of servers to handle auth, routing, rate limiting, and governance (e.g. agentgateway, Cloudflare MCP).

tools.name: MCP Reference Servers
tools.connects_to: Canonical reference implementations (filesystem, fetch, git, memory, sequential-thinking, and more) plus the official SDKs that power nearly all MCP clients and servers
strengths: 91,449 GitHub stars — the center of gravity for the ecosystem
SDKs hit 97M monthly downloads in March 2026
Defines the protocol spec and canonical server patterns
tools.best_for: Developers building or learning MCP servers and clients from authoritative reference code

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Repository automation, issues, pull requests, code search, and GitHub Actions via managed OAuth
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; usage billed through existing GitHub pricing
strengths: 33,828 GitHub stars
Managed OAuth removes credential leakage risk
Official remote server works in CI and agent workflows
tools.best_for: AI agents automating repo triage, PR reviews, and development workflows

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation — 25+ tools for navigation, clicking, form filling, and testing using accessibility-tree snapshots (no vision models needed)
strengths: Reliable structured browser control without screenshot processing
Runs in GitHub Actions / CI pipelines
Backed by Microsoft's Playwright framework
tools.best_for: AI-driven web testing and browser automation

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: A unified MCP endpoint for 1,500+ apps (GitHub, Slack, databases, and more) with a self-learning tool-selection layer
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based paid tiers above free plan limits
strengths: 1B+ tool calls run on the platform
Self-learning layer improves accuracy ~30% on 2x fewer tokens for repeat tasks
Single endpoint replaces dozens of individual server integrations
tools.best_for: Teams needing broad multi-app agent integrations through one managed endpoint

tools.name: Figma MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Design file access — reading frames, components, and design tokens so agents can translate designs to code
tools.pricing_paid: Available with Figma paid plans; OAuth-secured remote server
strengths: Official OAuth-secured remote server
Bridges design-to-code workflows
No local install required
tools.best_for: Generating code and assets directly from Figma designs

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: A registry and hosting platform for discovering, deploying, and connecting to thousands of MCP servers
tools.pricing_paid: Paid hosting and higher usage tiers
strengths: Large searchable registry of community and official servers
One-click deployment and hosting
Strong discovery layer for the long tail of servers
tools.best_for: Finding and deploying MCP servers without manual setup

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Hosting and securing remote MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers with built-in OAuth, edge deployment, and durable state
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans based on usage
strengths: First-class remote MCP hosting at the edge
Built-in OAuth and authorization support
Scales globally with low latency
tools.best_for: Deploying production remote MCP servers with managed auth and scale

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Reading and writing Notion pages, databases, and docs via an OAuth-secured remote server
strengths: Official OAuth remote server
Popular knowledge-base integration for agents
No local install
tools.best_for: Agents managing docs, notes, and structured knowledge in Notion

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Database queries, schema management, and project operations on Supabase Postgres via OAuth
strengths: Official OAuth-secured remote server
Direct database and backend control for agents
Tight integration with the Supabase platform
tools.best_for: AI agents querying and managing Postgres databases and backends

tools.name: n8n MCP
tools.connects_to: Exposes n8n workflow automation as MCP tools and lets agents trigger or build 400+ integration workflows
tools.pricing_paid: n8n Cloud paid plans and self-hosted enterprise tiers
strengths: Bridges agents to a huge library of automation workflows
Self-hostable and open source core
Combines MCP with established workflow tooling
tools.best_for: Connecting AI agents to complex multi-step automation pipelines

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Payment operations — creating customers, invoices, payment links, and querying financial data via OAuth
strengths: Official OAuth-secured remote server
Enables agentic commerce and billing flows
Trusted payments vendor
tools.best_for: Agents handling payments, billing, and financial automation

tools.name: agentgateway
tools.connects_to: A proxy/gateway that routes, secures, and governs traffic between agents and multiple MCP servers with observability and policy controls
strengths: Centralized auth, routing, and rate limiting across servers
Observability and governance for enterprise MCP fleets
Protocol-aware proxying
tools.best_for: Enterprises governing many MCP servers behind a single controlled entry point

tools.name: Docker MCP
tools.connects_to: Container lifecycle management — building, running, and managing Docker containers and the MCP Catalog/Toolkit for packaging servers
strengths: Secure containerized execution of MCP servers
Official MCP Catalog and Toolkit for discovery
Reduces local setup friction
tools.best_for: Running and distributing MCP servers in isolated containers
